lobby.title: Registration at the lobby
lobby.p1: Upon arrival, please present yourself at the main lobby with your ID to register.
lobby.p2: Each registered guest will receive a wristband for the duration of your stay.
lobby.p3: This wristband will be cut off at the moment of check-out.

door.title: Entry to the apartment
door.text: Touch the smart lock screen so the keypad appears and enter the code you received previously.
